source.title: In-Depth Jewelcrafting Guide for World of Warcraft

notes: Original firsthand TGEXP guide lists 1000 Mithril Ore as prospected, with 70 Aquamarine units reported. Its page says updated for patch 8.3 but the sample acquisition date and game build are NOT stated. 200 is only a nominal five-ore batch equivalent, NOT a logged/verified completed-cast denominator; no click ledger, saved variables, hit counts, misses, refunds, skill or yield histogram. Treat all gem rows for the same ore quantity as one putative pooled cohort to avoid repeating denominators. Do not equate material quantity to hits or infer per-cast probabilities; no present-Retail validation. Separate farming-only totals on page excluded.
